d.title: Danshi Koukousei no Nichijou Specials
d.en: Daily Lives of High School Boys Specials
d.synopsis: The clueless boys of Sanada North High School never lack a new topic to dissect. Questions about girls are endless, the true meaning of being a man could be hidden in questionable chivalry, and there might be a moral side to silly pranks. With a different predicament always ongoing, the daily lives of high school boys are anything but boring.
